info.title: Invitation Platform API
info.description: Back end for the digital invitation platform. See app/api-contract.md for the human-readable contract.

get.summary: Plans, extras, themes, sections and languages
Stream a library track (MP3, supports Range requests)
Published testimonials. Sample (placeholder) copy has isSample: true; label it as such. May be empty.

put.summary: Upsert abandoned-cart draft (called on each wizard step)

post.summary: Server-side price preview. Without themeKey, the event's saved theme is used when eventId is sent; with no theme at all → 422 'Please choose a design'

Create order + payment checkout session; returns redirect URL. Pay to publish: add-ons the event uses must be in extras, else 422 INVALID_SELECTION when extra_language units fall short: details.missing[].qty = units still short (not the total needed).
Price add-ons for an already paid event (owner). 422 INVALID_SELECTION when extra_language units fall short: details.missing[].qty = units still short (not the total needed).

Add-ons-only checkout for an already paid event (cohost); returns redirect URL. 422 INVALID_SELECTION when extra_language units fall short: details.missing[].qty = units still short (not the total needed).
Stripe events (signature verified)
Email delivery events (x-webhook-secret)
Check a one-time link before showing the form
Create a self-serve event (free draft; publishing requires the self-serve plan)

patch.summary: Edit event details. Paid event with languages over the cap → 402 ADDON_PAYMENT_REQUIRED: details.missing[].qty = units still short (not the total needed).

get.summary: Purchased, available and missing add-ons (feeds the Add-ons checkout dialog)
Data export (JSON) of everything stored for this event

post.summary: multipart/form-data upload, field "file"

get.summary: Own-song rights confirmations ("Rights confirmed by <name> on <date>")

post.summary: Record "I have the rights to use this music" for an uploaded song or a song link
Approve the final design (irreversible)

put.summary: Self-serve editor save. content/config/theme go to the draft; locale applies immediately. The link is changed with PATCH …/invitation/slug

patch.summary: Custom link name (custom_link): change the invitation slug. Applies immediately; the old slug 301-redirects. 402 ADDON_PAYMENT_REQUIRED: details.missing[].qty = units still short (not the total needed).

post.summary: Publish / Publish changes. Unpaid add-ons in use → 402 ADDON_PAYMENT_REQUIRED: details.missing[].qty = units still short (not the total needed).
Reset the draft to the live version
Rotate the preview link
Manually add a guest (e.g. phone RSVP)

delete.summary: Move to trash, or ?permanent=true to delete a trashed guest

post.summary: Download guests as xlsx (sheets Guests + Companions) or csv
Invalidate the old personal link and issue a new one
Mark as sent after sharing manually (e.g. WhatsApp)
Schedule a bulk invite / reminder / update / thank-you (email channel; WhatsApp coming later)
Count recipients for a segment

get.summary: Tables, floor layout, assignments and confirmed parties

put.summary: Full replace with optimistic version check (409 VERSION_CONFLICT)

post.summary: Propose (or apply) seats for unseated guests

get.summary: Everything needed to render a guest invitation

post.summary: Open analytics ping
Submit an RSVP

get.summary: Read my own reply (editToken or personal link token)
Pipeline list (staff see assigned events only)

post.summary: Manual order (phone / bank transfer). Emails a set-password link — never a password.

get.summary: Kanban column counts for studio events

delete.summary: Soft-delete an event and its guests (admin only)

post.summary: Email the owner a set-password / sign-in link

patch.summary: Edit brief at any time (even locked)

post.summary: Add sections to a brief; host is asked to complete & resubmit
Fill invitation content/config from the brief (draft)
Reset the draft to the live version
Refund a MANUAL order (admin only; no money moves). Same effects as a Stripe refund. Checkout orders → 409 (refund in Stripe); already refunded → 409
